The '''Neimoidia system''' or '''Neimoidian system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]], the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] homeworld, as well as several other planets:
[[Deel]], a molten rock, [[Moonan]], a toxic wasteland, and [[Partainu]], a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]].
Neimoidia system also contained an extremely mineral-rich asteroid belt, [[Saak Sooin]], which the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] people sold at overwhelming prices.
